description: Agent submission of a payer prior-authorization request. Evidence is reference-shaped: the schema requires an opaque patient reference and a clinical-justification document reference and closes additionalProperties, so no unmodeled field (e.g. patient_name) or document payload can ride along and still grade conformant. The verifier enforces the SHAPE — which fields are present, and that no others are — but the reference fields are free strings and it cannot police their contents (string-format constraints such as a hash pattern are outside its enforceable keyword set). Populating patient_ref and clinical_justification_ref with opaque ids/hashes rather than PHI or document contents is therefore the integrator's contract, not a schema-enforced guarantee. When payer_allowlist is bound, the payer must be a member of it.
